text: January, nineteen nineteen. Boston, just after noon.
By the harbour stands a giant steel tank...
fifty feet tall, holding over two million gallons
It has leaked since the day it was built.
So the owners painted it brown... to hide the streaks.
Witnesses hear rivets popping like gunfire.
A wave of syrup, reportedly up to forty feet high,
rolls through the streets at thirty-five miles an hour.
It crushes buildings and bends an elevated railway.
In the freezing air, it sets like glue around the rescuers.
The company blamed saboteurs. A court blamed the tank.
For years, locals said the streets still smelled sweet.
could you outrun a wave of syrup?
